critical_code_review_comments: Spec vs impl deviation (non-blocking): review_request stated quick-action modal data-testids should be 'quick-action-{assign-test|schedule-interview|generate-offer|convert-employee}-modal'; actual implementation uses shorter keys — 'quick-action-test-modal', 'quick-action-interview-modal', 'quick-action-offer-modal', 'quick-action-convert-modal'. Buttons/submit/select testids (hr-action-*, qa-submit-btn, qa-test-select, qa-test-deadline) all match. Recommend either aligning naming to spec or updating spec/docs so downstream automation uses the canonical shorter names.

Applications tab renders application rows as flex divs (not <tr>); rows carry data-testid='app-PR-HR-YYYY-#####' rather than 'application-row-*'. Consider standardising to 'application-row-*' as originally documented so tests are more predictable.
